messages:
maya: Quick report: small repro where Vite/Rollup edge bundles drop Authorization during SDK retry. Happens only when package exports resolve to ESM entry.

oz: can you share the build steps?

maya: super minimal:
1) git clone https://example/repro-edge-sdk
2) npm ci && npm run build:edge (vite target)
3) npm run serve:edge (local edge shim)
4) curl -H "Authorization: Bearer TOKEN" http://localhost:8787/api/proxy -> first request 200, retry 403

maya: inspecting dist shows vite-inlined helper using `new Request(req)` instead of `req.clone()` which in our edge shim loses header iterators. CJS build uses clone() and works.

rachel: interesting. did you try changing import style? default vs `import * as SDK`?

maya: yes — namespace import sometimes forces a different interop path and avoids the inlined helper, but that's not reliable across plugin sets.

maya: short mitigation I validated: make SDK retry use clone when available and fallback to copying headers explicitly. small snippet:
```js
function cloneSafe(req){
  if (typeof req.clone === 'function') return req.clone();
  const h = new Headers();
  for (const [k,v] of (req.headers||[])) h.set(k,v);
  return new Request(req.url,{method:req.method,headers:h,body:req.body});
}
```

oz: please open an issue and add the repro. assign eng-runtime + devex.

devx-bot: Issue created: redwood/sdk#4307 1 assigned to @rachel and @eng-runtime. CI job queued.

maya: branch pushed: devex/edge-clone-safe with CI that builds vite/rollup/webpack and runs edge shim. Will follow up with PR to SDK once eng-runtime signs off.

rachel: thanks Maya, we'll add a short note in the SDK docs advising a temporary import-style workaround until patch ships.
